decisive_items: wide fibroblast proliferation, extremely similar to a fibroma
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy yielded a hypocellular sample with erythrocytes, histiocytes, and neutrophils
response.rationale: The intraoral incisional biopsy results are more specific to fibroma than the fine-needle aspiration biopsy results are to fibrous histiocytoma

rejected.why: Lipoma is less likely due to the presence of histiocytes and fibroblast proliferation
Benign salivary gland tumor is less likely due to the location and characteristics of the mass not being specific to salivary gland tumors
